additional_info.subject: 0402308 - ID0402308-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R5 170001908]16 times attempt to complete successful charging session CRM:00472000266
additional_info.body:
Hello Basheer,
I have a attached the logs on the ticket. There was a charging interruption due to plausibility check on the temperature sensors inside the plug. This can be related to a bad superficial contact between plug and car socket that lead to one DC pin get higher temperature that the other, specially in high current sessions.
The attempts to start the charging session are related to a huge amount of remote start transaction requests after the first one being accepted. The picture bellow shows exactly this.
I don't see anything wrong here. Let me know if you need additional information or if we can proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
